title: Add IngredientsView with scaling and checkbox state
description: Create IngredientsView.swift. Displays a list of Recipe.ingredients. A section header row shows 'Ingredients' on the leading edge and a Picker (bound to the external Scale binding) on the trailing edge. Each ingredient row has: a tappable circular checkbox (circle / checkmark.circle.fill) toggling local non-persistent 'gathered' state; the ingredient name (strikethrough + .secondary foreground when gathered); and the scaled quantity trailing, computed via RecipeScale.apply(to:). Empty state shows 'No ingredients listed' centered in .secondary foreground.
acceptance_criteria: Section header shows 'Ingredients' leading and scale Picker trailing bound to external binding.
Each row shows checkbox, name, and scaled quantity.
Tapping the checkbox toggles gathered state without persistence.
Gathered rows render name with .strikethrough() and .secondary foreground.
Quantities: .number scaled per RecipeScale rules, .text unchanged, nil hidden.
Empty state 'No ingredients listed' shown when Recipe.ingredients is empty.
Gathered state is non-persistent and resets when the view is re-initialised.
